function.description: Execute one exact approved full-position close using a reduce-only Lighter market IOC order. Direct calls are refused. The privileged runtime revalidates the unchanged position, market precision, full visible depth at the approved worst price, registered key, and nonce; signs TxType 14 locally; stages identity before one submission; and never retries ambiguity. Returns the exact fill and resulting position, including partial closes without automatic resubmission, or a pending or ambiguous state when final evidence is unavailable.
function.name: lighter__position_close
